answer: The terrace multiplier is published, charged in wander, and onyx lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 19 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 2399 identities would post 1904 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
